episodes.name: Crazy Love
episodes.overview: Jean-Luc celebrates a lonely birthday; Dana tutors Rich and romance blossoms.

episodes.name: Road Trip
episodes.overview: JT, Rich and Dana take a trip to Mexico and wind up in jail; Jean-Luc takes driving lessons from Carol.

episodes.name: Sex, Lies and Videotape
episodes.overview: 19-Year-old JT dates a 29-year-old woman with an ulterior motive; Mark and his buddies are caught watching an adult video.

episodes.name: Just Say Maybe
episodes.overview: Al is tempted to toke at a rock concert; Carol's married friend Patti is tempted by Jean-Luc.

episodes.name: The "L" Word
episodes.overview: Rich tries not to be jealous when Dana's old boyfriend arrives; Frank and Jean-Luc go on a disastrous camping trip.

episodes.name: She's the One
episodes.overview: JT finds romance with a female tow-truck operator, but his fear of commitment may stall the courtship.

episodes.name: Independence Day
episodes.overview: JT moves out of the house--and into Jean-Luc's. Meanwhile, Carol tries to spend more time with the girls.

episodes.name: Reality Bites
episodes.overview: Carol and Jean-Luc vie for Lilly's attentions; JT and Rich are evicted from their new apartment by their new landlord--Frank.

episodes.name: Locket Man
episodes.overview: Rich's gift to Dana turns out out be a locket he'd given another girl years earlier; meanwhile, Frank begins to feel his age.

episodes.name: How the West Was Won
episodes.overview: Frank falls asleep in front of the TV, prompting a dream of the Old West in which he's a drunken sheriff.

episodes.name: Absolutely Fabio
episodes.overview: Jean-Luc gets to cut Fabio's hair; Carol bets Dana that she can't supervise a children's birthday party.

episodes.name: Loose Lips
episodes.overview: Mark's big date backfires and makes him the laughingstock of the school; Karen's collagen injections make her lips huge.

episodes.name: The Big Date
episodes.overview: Al has a date with the pizza guy; Dana, Rich, JT and Sam go to a concert in Chicago; and Jean-Luc dumps his lenses.

episodes.name: Future Shock
episodes.overview: Rich and Dana feel matrimonial pressure after attending a friend's wedding; Jean-Luc and Frank get zonked on homemade medicine.

episodes.name: Show Me the Money
episodes.overview: Frank and his buddy challenge Carol and Jean-Luc to a bowling contest; JT and Rich fancy themselves sports agents.

episodes.name: It Didn't Happen One Night
episodes.overview: Karen's ego takes a hit when the boy she's after goes for Al instead. Meanwhile, Carol and Dana crave attention from Frank and Rich.

episodes.name: Macho Man
episodes.overview: Sam beats JT at every game they play, causing him to question his manhood and the future of their relationship.

episodes.name: Ain't Misbehavin'
episodes.overview: JT is jealous when Sam finds a roommate; meanwhile, Jean-Luc is in trouble with taxes, so Frank and Carol try to help.

episodes.name: The Facts of Life
episodes.overview: Frank and Carol tell Lilly about the facts of life, she then tells her kindergarten classmates; JT and Rich play the horses.

episodes.name: Talking Trash
episodes.overview: Frank's birthday gift to Carol is a dud; Rich teams with a cheerleader for a science contest.

episodes.name: Walk Like a Man
episodes.overview: Mark is embarrassed by Carol's cheering at his basketball games; Rich takes heat from JT for kowtowing to Dana.

episodes.name: Shear Madness
episodes.overview: Jean-Luc panics when he discovers he'll be cutting the First Lady's hair; Frank finds a guy for Al.

episodes.name: The Kissing Game
episodes.overview: Carol fixes up Jean-Luc with a blind date; the kids use the salon as a make-out parlor.

episodes.name: Bonjour Jean-Luc
episodes.overview: Carol introduces Jean-Luc to Frank, who dislikes him immediately; JT tries to learn to dance.
